summary.text: Michael Hasty is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 135, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran who works in marketing and sales, Hasty also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Michael Hasty was born in Maryland Heights, Missouri, and graduated from Mascoutah Community High School.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2005 to 2009, and earned an associate degree from Arkansas State University in 2013 and a graduate degree from Capella University in 2019.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Hasty said he spent 14 years of his childhood as a foster child in Missouri and Illinois, served a 14-month tour in Iraq, and holds an MBA in Finance and Supply Chain Management.
He said he is employed in sales and marketing in Branson, Missouri, and is the parent of four children.
Betsy Fogle defeated Hasty in the general election for Missouri House District 135 on November 5, 2024.
In the 2024 survey, Hasty listed economic growth and jobs, training and equipment for law enforcement and first responders, and investment in public schools and educators as his key messages.
